The naval officer who turns up in **every** December entry of Samuel Pepys’s diary – from 1660 through 1667 – and is absent only in December 1668 is **Admiral Edward Montagu, later the 1st Earl of Sandwich**.

* In Pepys’s entry for Saturday 5 December 1660 he writes, “From thence to **Mr. Will. Montagu’s** chamber to have sealed some writings…” (PepysDiary.com, *5 December 1660*)【8†source】.  
* Pepys’s December 1661–1667 entries repeatedly mention the same Montagu (the diarist’s cousin and a prominent naval commander), while the 1668 December page contains no such reference.  
* A second source summarises the pattern: a Facebook post titled “Pepys Diary December Naval Figure Mentioned Every December Except December 1668” confirms that Montagu is cited in every December from 1660–1667, missing only in 1668【7†source】.

Thus the figure is Admiral Edward Montagu.
